nom: Vichy Normaderm PhytoAction Acne Control Daily Face Moisturizer

segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers are a large and mostly satisfied group, saying it controls shine and leaves skin matte or less oily without feeling greasy; the dissent is one reviewer who found it heavier than her usual lightweight moisturizer and says it left her face oily by the end of the day.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are mixed: some, including one with dry, sensitive, eczema-prone skin, say it never burns and hydrates well even in winter, while others say it isn't moisturizing enough on its own and recommend layering a separate moisturizer for very dry skin.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including some who react badly to most acne products and one with eczema, mostly report no burning or irritation and call it gentle enough for reactive skin; one wishes the fragrance were left out given the sensitive-skin claim.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers are consistently positive, reporting the moisturizer balances oily and dry zones, clears closed comedones and blackheads, and leaves skin more hydrated without heaviness.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the moisturizer keeps skin hydrated without drying it out, including several who specifically note it doesn't dry skin the way other acne treatments do; a consistent minority say it isn't moisturizing enough on its own, especially for drier skin, and recommend layering a separate moisturizer or using more product than expected to feel hydrated.
concerns.redness: The reviewers who mention redness say it fades within days of use, including one whose cystic acne redness cleared within a couple of days and another who reports no redness or itching from the product at all.
concerns.spots: The one reviewer who tracks acne scars specifically says hers began lightening within two weeks of consistent use.
concerns.blemishes: The majority of reviewers report real improvement in their acne, from fewer new pimples to complete clearing of cystic or hormonal breakouts within one to a few weeks; there is real dissent too, with one reviewer saying it made her breakouts worse and painful, and others reporting no noticeable change in their pimples after three weeks to a month of use.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers focused on oil control say the moisturizer leaves skin matte or noticeably less oily, including several who credit it with reducing sebum production over weeks to months of use; the dissent is a reviewer who found it heavier than her usual moisturizer and says it left her face oily by the end of the day.

aspects.libelle: Strong or unpleasant scent for some
Some feel it's not worth the price

extraits.texte: I never leave any reviews but I just have to in order to help others save money. DO NOT BUY THIS. Absolutely awful. It made my skin worse. Painful breakouts. Heavily scented. Worst part is I used it for months to try to give it an honest chance and now I can't even get my money back.

Does mot dry out my skin which is better than other acne prone products, however does not help like the description states. My skin stays the same after a month using. I would not say it works like other regular moisturizers because this one doesn't have that much mostuirizing.

extraits.titre: Normaderm PhytoAction Acne Control Daily Moisturiz
extraits.texte: This is my first experience using a product from Vichy Laboratories. The lotion is light-weight, gel-like, and absorbs quickly into the skin. It is oil-free, silicone-free, non-greasy, and mattifying. It is advertised as being good for sensitive skin, however, I wish it did not have fragrance added as I feel that would be better suited for those with sensitive skin. Skin feels moisturized but not greasy, and not clogged. However, it didn't feel moisturizing enough for me and I think it would be better suited for someone with oily skin versus my skin which tends to be somewhat dry. I will finish this bottle. At this point I am not sure if I will continue to use, but will decide upon finishing the bottle.

I used this for about three weeks before writing my review. As of writing this I've noticed no difference in how much less oily my skin is or how many pimples I get. Compared to my usual facial moisturizer (Tarte Awake Pore Down) this one is heavier and leaves my face feeling oily towards the end of the day. I don't think it's worth the cost and I probably wouldn't recommend it to anyone because it didn't do what it said it would.

I have dry sensitive skin with eczema so I struggle to find acne products that are effective without being irritating. I'm surprised how much I like this! It never burns, even on my driest skin days in the middle of December. And it does work really well for my hormonal acne and blackheads, I can tell a difference overnight :) not sure how it would work for oily skin types, but I'd recommend for normal-dry!

extraits.titre: Combats acne, enlarged pores, and blackheads
extraits.texte: My skin used to be much more acne prone than it is now but even in my late 30's, I still experience blackheads and breakouts. Ugh! I also have combination skin - oily in some areas, dry in others - so finding that perfect product that doesn't leave my skin looking shiny or flaky can be tricky. The Vichy Laboratories Normaderm PhytoAction Acne Control Daily Moisturizer is a lightweight formula that doesn't leave my skin feeling heavy or coated. I have been using this for around a month and have noticed some results. Granted, my skin isn't in really bad shape like it used to be but I do have some blemishes and also some minor blackheads around my nose area. When used in combination with the Vichy Laboratories Normaderm PhytoAction Acne Control Daily Deep Cleansing Gel, my problem areas have pretty much vanished. No more blemishes, no more blackheads (which is HUGE), and my pores appear to be considerably smaller. I was getting frustrated at first because I didn't see results for awhile. So, keep trying! The moisturizer is easy to dispense and goes on smoothly. A little really goes a long way. My skin is left feeling soft, silky, and smooth, NOT greasy. Overall, I was quite impressed with this product and would highly recommend it to anyone that is dealing with pesky acne breakouts and blackheads!

I started applying the moisturizer once a day by massaging it into my skin lightly and evenly. By day 3 I started washing and moisturizing my face morning and night. During this time I noticed my pores were getting smaller and less visible. On the 2 week I began washing and moisturizing 3x a day. I noticed in hotter days my face would be very oily and I felt like the moisturizer was melting into my skin. I did not like that feeling so I increased to washing and moisturizing 3x a day. Within a week and a half I began to notice my face looked brighter and shinier. Within 2 weeks I notice my acne scars were lightening up. I really enjoyed using these products. The only thing I wish was included was a facial scrub. This product made my skin feel softer, cleaner, brighter and less oily. I would definitely continue using these products.
